mapper.select: select q.insp_id, q.insp_no, q.insp_type, q.lot_id, q.item_id, q.status, q.result, q.judged_at, q.judged_by, q.voided_at, q.voided_by, i.lot_ctrl_yn from qms_insp q join mst_item i on i.item_id = q.item_id where q.insp_id = #{inspId}

select n.ncr_id, n.ncr_no, n.lot_id, n.item_id, n.unit_cd, i.unit_cd as item_unit_cd, n.status, n.closed_at, n.closed_by, i.lot_ctrl_yn, (select r.node_id from wms_cust_rtn r where n.src_type = 'WMS_CUST_RTN' and r.rtn_id = n.src_id) as rtn_node_id from qms_ncr n join mst_item i on i.item_id = n.item_id where n.ncr_id = #{ncrId}
select d.disp_id, d.line_no, d.disp_type, d.qty from qms_ncr_disp d where d.ncr_id = #{ncrId} order by d.line_no
select s.stock_id, s.plant_cd, s.node_id, s.stock_status, s.qty from inv_stock s where s.lot_id = #{lotId} and s.stock_status = #{status} and s.qty > 0 order by s.node_id
select s.stock_id, s.plant_cd, s.node_id, s.stock_status, s.qty from inv_stock s where s.stock_id in #{id} order by s.item_id, s.node_id, s.lot_id nulls first, s.stock_status for update

select t.trx_id from inv_trx t where t.src_type = #{srcType} and t.src_id = #{srcId} and t.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from inv_trx r where r.reversal_of_id = t.trx_id) order by t.trx_id
select distinct s.plant_cd from inv_stock s where s.lot_id = #{lotId} and s.qty <> 0 order by 1

select distinct t.plant_cd from inv_trx t where t.src_type = 'QMS_INSP' and t.lot_id = #{lotId} and t.reversal_of_id is null and t.trx_type = 'STATUS_IN' and t.stock_status <> 'QC' and not exists (select 1 from inv_trx r where r.reversal_of_id = t.trx_id) order by 1
select q.result from qms_insp q where q.lot_id = #{lotId} and q.insp_type in ('RECEIVE', 'FINAL') and q.status = 'JUDGED' order by q.judged_at desc, q.insp_id desc limit 1

select t.plant_cd, t.node_id, sum(t.qty) as qty from inv_trx t where t.lot_id = #{lotId} and t.stock_status = 'BLOCKED' and t.trx_type in ('RCV_PRD', 'RCV_MAT', 'RCV_PO') and t.recorded_at >= #{since} group by t.plant_cd, t.node_id having sum(t.qty) > 0 order by t.node_id

select n.ncr_no from inv_trx t join qms_ncr_disp d on d.disp_id = t.src_id join qms_ncr n on n.ncr_id = d.ncr_id where t.src_type = 'QMS_NCR' and t.lot_id = #{lotId} and t.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from inv_trx r where r.reversal_of_id = t.trx_id) order by t.trx_id limit 1
select distinct s.plant_cd from inv_stock s where s.stock_status = 'QC' and s.lot_id is not null and s.qty > 0 order by 1

select count(*) from (select s.lot_id, sum(s.qty) as qc from inv_stock s where s.plant_cd in #{p} and s.stock_status = 'QC' and s.lot_id is not null and s.qty > 0 group by s.lot_id) x join lateral (select max(q.judged_at) as judged_at from qms_insp q where q.lot_id = x.lot_id and q.insp_type in ('RECEIVE', 'FINAL') and q.status = 'JUDGED') j on j.judged_at is not null where not exists (select 1 from qms_insp q where q.lot_id = x.lot_id and q.insp_type in ('RECEIVE', 'FINAL') and q.status = 'OPEN') and x.qc > coalesce((select sum(t.qty) from inv_trx t where t.lot_id = x.lot_id and t.stock_status = 'QC' and t.recorded_at >= j.judged_at and (t.trx_type in ('RCV_PRD', 'RCV_MAT', 'RCV_PO') or (t.src_type = 'QMS_INSP' and t.trx_type = 'STATUS_IN'))), 0)

select count(distinct q.insp_id) from inv_trx t join qms_insp q on q.insp_id = t.src_id where t.src_type = 'QMS_INSP' and q.status = 'VOID' and t.reversal_of_id is null and t.trx_type = 'STATUS_IN' and t.stock_status <> 'QC' and not exists (select 1 from inv_trx r where r.reversal_of_id = t.trx_id)
